theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_atl_pc_tangent_iff_of_integral_sub_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M M' : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P), (∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Euclid P) ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y ∂μHE[n]) - ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M', f y ∂μHE[n]) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
